why_latin_square: Each task uses 4 DIFFERENT parent states from 23-27 (not a single state per task)
States distributed via label-independent rule: state = 23 + ((task + j) % 5) for j=0,1,2,3
Selection algorithm is pre-registered and reproducible without reading dev labels
Dev NC gate shortfall (14 < 20) was KNOWN at design time, but individual dev label values were NOT used to select reserve members
perturbation_strategy: 4 global perturbation templates: P1(+5mm x), P2(-5mm x), P3(+5mm y), P4(-5mm y)
Each task's 4 cells use all 4 templates, rotated via j index
No yaw perturbations in dev (preserves simpler perturbation space for model selection)

latin_square_rule.formula: for task t in 0..9, for j in 0..3: state = 23 + ((t + j) % 5), template = P{j+1}

effective_duplicate_check.note: All 40 cells must be unique in dev-reserve internally and vs dev-primary

collection_rule: All 40 cells must be collected. Must NOT stop early even if dev NC reaches 20 after fewer cells. Must complete all 40.
